newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-HK's Chan warns against HK$ 1997 speculation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-HK's Chan warns against HK$ 1997 speculation.

text.p: Hong Kong's Chief Secretary, Anson Chan, said on Tuesday the territory's monetary authorities were fully prepared for any speculative activity on the Hong Kong dollar in the lead-up to the handover to China in 1997.
Chan told a new conference fund mangers such as George Soros should be aware that such speculation would be unsuccessful.

"I think that the Hong Kong authorities have been very clear, and you will not expect us to do anything less, to demonstrate to Mr Soros and others of a like mind that speculation on the Honk Kong dollar will not get them anywhere," Chan said.
Chan said the Hong Kong dollar would remain pegged to the U.S. dollar after the July 1997 hand over.
"We don't expect the Hong Kong dollar to come under pressure, but of course it is a risk that we always have to remain alert to," she said.
"But we will be fully prepared for any speculative activities," she added.
